prompt:

Header text verbatim: "borde". Smaller English meaning verbatim: "should".
Scene: One adult advising a friend to take an umbrella while rain is visible outside, umbrella offered in one hand, no written speech bubbles.
Memory-link caption verbatim: "borde = should; giving advice.".
Swedish example in bottom strip verbatim: "Du borde ta med ett paraply.".
Teach only the sense shown by this sentence. Print only the supplied heading, English meaning, memory caption and Swedish example. If the caption contains a sound/spelling association, mark it with the small exact label "Memory trick".
